cases.question: 2026 年 8 月青禾的创建订单数、支付订单数、有效订单数和取消订单数分别是多少？

actual.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_order_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_order_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_order_count
FROM "data"."main"."orders_enriched" orders_enriched_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
actual.answer: 2026年8月（8月1日至8月31日，按下单日期统计）当前客户青禾的CRM会员账户范围内：创建订单数 34,306 单；支付订单数 31,564 单；有效订单数 29,933 单；取消订单数 2,742 单。口径上，创建订单数统计全部订单且包含取消单；支付订单数统计状态为已支付的订单，包括后来全部退款的订单；有效订单数统计已支付且实付金额减退款金额大于零的订单，取消和全退不计；取消订单数统计状态为取消的订单。结果未按门店等维度拆分；数据为合成测试数据，覆盖至2026-09-01。

cases.question: 2026 年 8 月青禾的退款订单数、部分退款订单数和全额退款订单数各是多少？

actual.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refund_order_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 AND refund_cents < paid_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partial_refund_order_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > 0 AND refund_cents = paid_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS full_refund_order_count
FROM "data"."main"."orders_enriched" orders_enriched_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
actual.answer: 2026年8月（2026-08-01至2026-09-01），在青禾当前已加载的CRM会员账户范围内：退款订单数4718单，其中部分退款订单数3087单，全额退款订单数1631单。部分退款与全额退款合计为4718单，与退款订单总数一致。口径为已支付且退款金额大于零的订单；数据来自本周合成测试库，覆盖至2026-09-01。

cases.question: 2026 年 8 月青禾的实付金额、退款金额、净销售额、支付订单原价金额和优惠金额分别是多少？

actual.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents ELSE 0 END) AS payment_cents
  , SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS refund_cents
  , SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS net_sales_cents
  , SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents ELSE 0 END) AS gross_cents
  , SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents - paid_cents ELSE 0 END) AS discount_cents
FROM "data"."main"."orders_enriched" orders_enriched_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
actual.answer: 在青禾当前客户范围内，按2026年8月（按下单日期归属，覆盖8月全月）统计：实付金额为5,702,706.46元；退款金额为563,493.26元；净销售额为5,139,213.20元；支付订单原价金额为6,337,632.45元；优惠金额为634,925.99元。口径上，实付金额未扣退款；退款按原订单下单日期归属，不按现金退款发生日；净销售额为实付减退款，取消单不计；优惠金额不因退款冲减。以上为合成测试库中青禾CRM会员账户范围的统计结果。
actual.question: 2026 年 8 月青禾的实付金额、退款金额、净销售额、支付订单原价金额和优惠金额分别是多少？

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END) AS buyer_count
  , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END) AS refund_buyer_count

cases.question: 2026 年 8 月青禾的有效订单均额、购买会员人均消费、购买频次和单均商品件数是多少？

actual.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_order_value
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_buyer_value
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS purchase_frequency
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS items_per_order
FROM "data"."main"."orders_enriched" orders_enriched_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
actual.answer: 青禾在 2026 年 8 月（2026-08-01 至 2026-09-01）全月汇总的有效订单均额为 171.69 元/单，购买会员人均消费为 311.39 元/账户，购买频次为 1.81 单/账户，单均商品件数为 4.02 件/单。口径分别为：有效订单均额=净销售额÷有效订单数；购买会员人均消费=净销售额÷购买会员数；购买频次=有效订单数÷购买会员数；单均商品件数=有效订单商品件数÷有效订单数。购买会员按 CRM 会员账户统计。本次结果为该客户范围内全月汇总，未按门店或地区分组；四项指标分母均非零。
actual.question: 2026 年 8 月青禾的有效订单均额、购买会员人均消费、购买频次和单均商品件数是多少？

cases.question: 2026 年 8 月青禾的退款金额占比、取消率、退款订单率和优惠率是多少？

actual.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_amount_rate
  , CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS cancel_rate

cases.question: 青禾 2026 年 7 月和 8 月的月内购买会员数、月内复购会员数和月内复购率，按月分别列出。

actual.sql:
WITH sma_10003_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', activity_month) AS metric_time__day
    , DATE_TRUNC('month', activity_month) AS metric_time__month
    , CASE WHEN monthly_member_activity_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __monthly_buyer_count
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."monthly_member_activity" monthly_member_activity_src_10000
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(subq_8.metric_time__month, subq_14.metric_time__month) AS metric_time__month
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(CAST(subq_14.monthly_repeat_buyer_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_14.monthly_buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS monthly_repeat_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , SUM(__monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
    , SUM(__monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_8
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , SUM(__monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
    , SUM(__monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_14
ON
  subq_8.metric_time__month = subq_14.metric_time__month
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(subq_8.metric_time__month, subq_14.metric_time__month)
actual.answer:
青禾客户范围内，按 CRM 会员账户统计，2026 年 7 月和 8 月均按完整自然月、全门店口径分别计算，结果如下：

- 2026 年 7 月：月内购买会员数 16,436 户，月内复购会员数 7,388 户，月内复购率 44.95%。
- 2026 年 8 月：月内购买会员数 16,504 户，月内复购会员数 7,302 户，月内复购率 44.24%。

口径说明：月内购买会员数指当月至少有 1 笔有效订单的账户数；月内复购会员数指当月至少有 2 笔有效订单的账户数；月内复购率=月内复购会员数÷月内购买会员数。两个月分别展示，不跨月加总人数。
actual.question: 青禾 2026 年 7 月和 8 月的月内购买会员数、月内复购会员数和月内复购率，按月分别列出。

WITH sma_10004_cte AS (

    DATE_TRUNC('day', activity_month) AS metric_time__day
    , CASE WHEN monthly_paid_member_activity_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __monthly_paid_buyer_count
    , valid_order_count AS __monthly_paid_order_count
    , net_sales_cents AS __monthly_paid_sales_cents
    , CASE WHEN valid_order_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count

SELECT

  SELECT
    store_id AS store
